faqs.a:
The application for an adult business license shall constitute consent of the licensee
               and his agents or employees to permit the city police department or any other agent
               of the city to conduct routine inspections of any licensed adult business during the
               hours the establishment is conducting business.
(Code 1981, § 4-34; Ord. No. 3217, § 3, 9-18-1995)
